original_wisa_caption: The video captures a nighttime scene featuring a police van driving through a snowy street. The van is white with "POLICE" written on its side and has its emergency lights flashing in blue and red. The vehicle's headlights illuminate the snow-covered ground ahead. In the background, another police car is partially visible, also with its lights on. A person dressed in dark clothing walks past the van, moving from left to right across the frame. The environment suggests an urban setting, with a building labeled "GRILLADES" visible in the background. The overall atmosphere is tense and urgent, typical of a police response to an incident. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing on the moving van and the surrounding activity.
caption: The video captures a nighttime exterior scene centered on a white police minivan parked facing the camera. Its headlights blaze, and a reversed POLICE decal stretches across the hood. The roof light bar flashes red and blue, with a green beacon at one end, while a blue side-marker beacon on the front fender pulses on and off. To the left, a dark SUV sits rear-on beside a vertical pole. A plume of white smoke or steam rises there, swirling upward and spreading near the pole. Beside the minivan's left-side window, a uniformed officer stands before a brick wall bearing a GRILLADE advertisement, shifting posture and leaning toward the window. A second police vehicle is partly visible at the right edge. The minivan appears stationary, its position against the pole and sign unchanged.
